create_deep_sea_environment: create a DeepSea environment with a given grid size for testing deep exploration
run_deep_sea_episode: run an episode of the DeepSea environment by calling reset and step actions
configure_deterministic_deep_sea: configure the DeepSea environment to use deterministic or stochastic windy transitions
review_deep_sea_action_mapping: review the DeepSea environment randomized action mapping that swaps left and right per state
summarize_deep_sea_observation: summarize the DeepSea observation spec which returns an N x N grid array
